name: Talking Avatar
summary: Animate one portrait from your original speech using FlashHead Lite streaming, 512x512 at 25 fps, square crop. Full audio up to 45 seconds.

source.template: SoulX-FlashHead Lite upstream streaming CLI, ROCm port 32b98ccf + Transformers 5 output capture
source.notes: Cloud9 file-backed VIDEO adapter, no new persistent service. Real Freefield CLI 45s/512x512/25fps validation passed; square crop and single visually reviewed scene; phoneme-level lip-sync not measured.

inputs.label: Portrait
inputs.help: Portrait frontal net, un visage, bouche visible, éclairage homogène. Cadrage final carré 512 × 512.

inputs.label: Original speech
inputs.help: Voix seule et intelligible, 2–45 s, sans musique ni réverbération marquée. Le modèle pilote la bouche et les mouvements à partir du son, sans prompt texte.

notes: Local Cloud9 backend with pinned FlashHead runtime required; no lip-sync claims beyond reviewed evidence. Use authorized portraits.
